svg.aria-label: ConvFinQA agent structure: a turn — the question plus the filing and the conversation history — passes through four typed pydantic-ai agents in sequence, triage then preprocess then retriever then calculator, all four loading one versioned prompt set; number turns short-circuit at the retriever and go straight to the answer, while program turns are computed through six explicit calculator tools.

g.title: the versioned prompt set — v1, v2, generated v3_1; a module per version, auto-discovered, loaded by all four agents
the turn — question plus the filing (text and table) plus the conversation history; roughly 60% of questions refer back to an earlier turn
triage agent — classifies the turn as number or program, and the conversation as Type I or Type II
preprocess agent — resolves "that" and "this change" against history, then decomposes the question into retrieval sub-questions and a calculation program
retriever agent — pulls the raw values out of the report's text and table, and answers number turns directly
calculator agent — executes the program through six explicit tools (add, subtract, multiply, divide, exp, greater), never free-text arithmetic
the answer — a number, scored against gold by exact match and by program match; the whole turn is written to the trace store

path.title: number turns short-circuit at the retriever and never reach the calculator

svg.text: champion v2 · v3_1 refused by the gate · every turn traced
